app.name: WC04 Camera (Pearl local test)
app.long_description: PRIVATE LOCAL TEST: font redistribution rights unverified. WC04 (057e:030a), IOS58 and writable SD required to save. A opens live view; 1 changes size; 2 checks camera; + selects Photo/Video; left/right selects Off/3/5/10 second timer. Photo: A captures, B cancels countdown or returns to menu. Video: A starts/stops silent sampled MJPEG AVI, max 60 seconds/128 MiB. HOME finalizes and exits. Host-tested and compiled, new UI/timers/video await physical Wii testing. If USB stopping waits, unplug camera. Temporary icon: Giuseppe Ramos / Vecteezy.com; see included licenses.
